plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner: a wide text column carries headline and benefit list, the CTA pill sits directly under the copy on its left edge with the logo/legal beside it, and the sneaker fills the right third as the visual anchor.
Three-act reading order: product image on the left, the message in the centre column, and the action column on the right with the CTA pill above the logo and fine print.

Brand-rail layout: a narrow left rail holds the logo pill and legal like a masthead, the copy takes the central half, and the sneaker sits top-right with the CTA pill centred beneath it so the product and action form one group.
